name_input: DOOWON CLIMATE CONTROL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/doowon-climate-control-india-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 21593 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 82', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every visible row is an INBOUND movement into India, e.g. '2026-02-28 | DOOWON CLIMATE CONTROL INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | DOOWON CLIMATE CONTROL CO LTD | RADIATOR CORE ASSY SP2 PE (12) - MR30673-1250- | CHENNAI SEA INMAA1, India | Pusan, SOUTH KOREA | 87089100 | BOL 1110521' and '2026-02-28 | ... | INNER CONDENSER CORE ASSY (CV) H30113-1800- | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | SEOUL INCHEON INT, SOUTH KOREA | 84159000 | BOL 1112081'. Origin is always the foreign supplier (Korea/China), destination is the Indian port — i.e. imports, not exports. No outbound shipment row with an Indian origin port and a foreign destination was seen.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract award or annual-report split could be retrieved. thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, eximpedia.app and trademo.com all returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge; the web_search tool was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the entire session, so no alternative source could be located.
note: Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey claims 21,593 total shipment records and 82 trading partners; only 5 individual rows were rendered in the free view, and all 5 are imports into India from Doowon Climate Control Co. Ltd (Pusan/Seoul, South Korea) — HS 87089100 (radiator cores), 84159000 (condenser cores) and 39269099 (plastic boxes). The declared HS 870891 is consistent with the radiator-core rows actually observed, so no HS correction is needed. IMPORTANT: the 21,593 figure is an aggregate of import records and must NOT be read as export volume; no export bill of lading with an Indian origin and foreign destination was found, therefore export_status is none_found rather than confirmed. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely unknown, not negative — the company is a Tier-1 automotive thermal-systems plant at Penukonda, Andhra Pradesh (address on the ImportKey page: '1ST FLOOR,NO.1-1917 KAMAN STREET,D ARGAPETA,PENUKONDA') supplying Korean OEM chains, which makes domestic OEM sales highly plausible, but per Rule 5 plausibility is not evidence and no GST turnover, tender or contract record was verified. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in any source reached; not estimated. No CIN, PAN or incorporation data verified (zaubacorp/thecompanycheck blocked), so those fields are left null rather than guessed. Recommendation: re-run this company when the search backend is restored and a GST/GSTIN lookup plus a paid Volza/Eximpedia export-side view is available.
